server_host.description: IP address or hostname for the FTP server to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: FTP control port to listen on.

timeout_seconds.description: Idle connection timeout in seconds. Increase for slow or large transfers.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable FTP over SSL/TLS (FTPS) for secure data transfer.

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

ftp_root_path.description: 1-Wire filesystem path to expose as FTP root (e.g., /, /bus.0, /system).

allow_anonymous.description: Allow login without credentials. Use with caution in production.

allow_write.description: Permit authenticated users to write to the 1-Wire filesystem. Enable only if needed.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent FTP connections.

bus_devices.description: List of 1-Wire bus device paths (e.g., /dev/w1_bus_master1) or 'auto' for auto-discovery.

log_file_path.description: Optional path to a log file. If empty or omitted, logging goes to syslog.

chroot_enabled.description: Chroot authenticated users to the FTP root for security isolation.

debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug output (not recommended for production).
